name: @katalyst/server-backend
description: Katalyst Server - Backend Data Services for Fly.io deployment

scripts.migrate: wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-main && wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-timeseries && wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-analytics && wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-audit
scripts.migrate:local: wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-main --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-timeseries --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-analytics --local && wrangler d1 migrations apply katalyst-server-audit --local
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration
scripts.build:wasm: wasm-pack build ./wasm/data_processor && wasm-pack build ./wasm/crypto && wasm-pack build ./wasm/compression

author: SWC Studio
